turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Tribuna de México reports that Senator Susana Zatarain has proposed up to 10 years in prison for water theft.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The bill would amend the Federal Penal Code and the National Waters Law to cover unauthorised extraction and clandestine wells.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? That reaches both the extraction and any tampering with pipes.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Los Cabos shut 25 illegal connections this year alone. [pause] That volume matters.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Those connections were stealing more than 300 litres per second across the municipality.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Conagua also shut two illegal sources in Cabo San Lucas that fed about 120 tanker trucks daily.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Only three in ten people in BCS have constant supply, according to INEGI's latest survey.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Palabra BCS adds that the BCS government lent a plot in Comondú to the National Guard for 30 years.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The same agreement donates two health buildings in La Paz and El Centenario to federal agencies.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: One building holds the haemodialysis unit and the chronic-disease clinic. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: This is Radio BCS2050. Our topic is Security. The question we will answer is how these measures affect water access and public infrastructure across the state.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: What would you ask the senator next?

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Tribuna de México reports that Senator Susana Zatarain has proposed adding an article to the Federal Penal Code.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: What exactly would that change cover?

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: It targets unauthorised water extraction, tampering with infrastructure, clandestine wells and illegal sales.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That list covers the main ways water gets taken without permission.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: And the penalty could reach ten years in prison.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Yes. The bill also amends the National Waters Law. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Los Cabos has already shut 25 illegal connections this year.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: 25 shut down already shows how active the problem remains.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The estimated theft runs above 300 litres per second.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That volume is enough to affect entire neighbourhoods waiting on trucks.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Conagua closed two illegal sources in Cabo San Lucas.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Those sources supplied roughly 120 tanker trucks a day.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Wait, 120 trucks every day from just two spots?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: INEGI’s 2025 survey shows only three in ten BCS residents receive constant supply.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So the theft hits people who already wait for water.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Exactly, the families without steady pipes feel it first.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Palabra BCS covered a different security step taken last month.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The state agreed to lend a plot in Comondú to the National Guard.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: For how long?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: 30 years, under a comodato agreement.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The same meeting also transferred two health buildings.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: One in La Paz went to the Health Ministry, the psychiatric hospital in El Centenario to IMSS Bienestar.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The La Paz site holds the haemodialysis unit and the mental-health services.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Both moves were approved by the state real-estate committee chaired by the governor.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The Guard site is meant for operations in the north of the state.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Water theft now carries a clear criminal label, while the Guard gains a long-term base.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: What would you ask the senator about enforcement in Los Cabos?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: How the new penalties would actually reach the tanker-truck networks.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: And whether 30 years is enough time for the Guard to change daily security in Comondú.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Those are the open questions after these two decisions. [pause]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: I keep wondering how the water fines would work alongside the Guard’s new site.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Tribuna de México reported on November 13 that Senator Susana Zatarain proposes up to ten years in prison for water theft.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The bill would add an article to the Federal Penal Code and change the National Waters Law to cover unauthorised extraction, tampering and clandestine wells.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: In Los Cabos the municipality already shut 25 illegal connections this year, with theft estimated above 300 litres per second.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Conagua also closed two illegal sources in Cabo San Lucas that had been supplying about 120 tanker trucks a day.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: INEGI's ENCIG 2025 survey shows only three in ten people across Baja California Sur receive water on a constant basis.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So the proposal lands in places already struggling with supply shortfalls.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Palabra BCS reported on October 21 that the state government agreed to lend a plot in Comondú to the National Guard for 30 years.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The loan covers operations in the north of the state and the decision came from the state real-estate committee chaired by the governor.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The same meeting also transferred two health buildings in La Paz and one psychiatric hospital in El Centenario to federal health agencies.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Comondú already hosts the main agro pole in Valle Santo Domingo and fisheries along the coast.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Los Cabos remains the primate municipality with the highest fiscal capacity and the main international gateway at SJD airport.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Its aquifers 0317 and 0319 are listed in deficit, which limits how much new supply can be added.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Mulegé north shows the same pattern of sparse services and long distances to markets.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The National Guard site in Comondú sits along the northern corridor that also carries the CFE Oasis H2 announcement from September 2026.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Water theft enforcement would therefore affect daily supply reliability in both the tourism-heavy south and the logistics corridor further north.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The 30-year term sets a long operational horizon for the Guard in an area that still lacks a public cadastre viewer.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Residents in Los Cabos and Comondú therefore face the same practical question of how enforcement and new federal presence change access to basic services.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The open question is whether the legal changes and the land loan will translate into measurable reductions in illegal extraction by the end of the current municipal plans.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The November 16 Foresight edition reports Los Cabos pursuing water theft cases while the Sea of Cortez forum debates doubling regional growth against aquifer limits.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That lines up with the water first scenario in the Base de datos BCS 2050.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Exactly. It calls for prioritising security on aquifers already in deficit, starting with 0313.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Just one aquifer at a time makes sense when the list is that long.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Next comes 0317, before any new growth is unlocked.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So the rule is clear: secure what exists first.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Then 0319 joins the list, followed by 0324.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Four so far. The scenario still mentions 0318 as well.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Right. The same edition ties coastal erosion from Punta Lobos to San Carlos directly to El Niño and extreme tides.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Which raises the question of who enforces the limits once the forum sets them.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The Los Cabos General Directorate of Public Security sits under Cap. de Fragata C.G. Christopher Jordi López Monge through 2027.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: His unit would handle the water theft enforcement the portal mentioned.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: On October 20 Congress approved donating three plots in Brisas del Valle to INSUS.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Those three plots sit in Ciudad Constitución, Comondú.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: One measures 27335 square metres.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That is a substantial parcel for social housing.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: A second one covers 17881 square metres.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The third reaches 13576 square metres, all in the same area.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: A fourth plot of 15550 square metres went to INFONAVIT in Santa Rosalía.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: All of it restricted to federal social housing only.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The signal also covers a similar donation in Mulegé.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The water first scenario says this housing cannot create new water availability.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: So the security directorate ends up guarding both supply and the new zones.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The ordinance references POERBCS policies of Sustainable Use, Preservation and Protection across 56 UGAs.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Urban deferrals like BCS40AS are listed in the planning guide.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: But here's the thing: the knowledge graph does not yet show how the security directorate will coordinate with those land-use rules when water theft cases cross municipal lines.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal's Foresight leaves open whether the same police structure can enforce both coastal erosion rules and aquifer protection at once [pause].

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: It also leaves open how the forum's economy target will be measured against the water actually secured first.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Tribuna de México reports authorities closed 25 illegal taps in Los Cabos.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: 25 taps? That points straight at the supply lines serving homes and hotels. I keep thinking about how one pipe can affect an entire neighborhood meter.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: They estimate the combined extraction runs above 300 liters per second.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: 300 liters every second? That volume leaves a big hole in what actually reaches the meters. It is like a hose running nonstop behind the scenes.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Each tap is an unauthorized pipe into the main lines.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So the water bypasses both billing and the treatment plants it was meant to reach. That turns a utility problem into something security teams must track.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The closures form part of the 2026 enforcement actions listed in the report.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That enforcement detail turns the issue into a security question as well as a utility one. [pause]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal notes a national announcement on Guardia Nacional infrastructure.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Yet specific barracks for Baja California Sur still lack a primary source. It leaves open how much local presence will grow.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Meanwhile the Los Cabos Hotel Association recorded fewer U.S. visitors through August 2026.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Senator Susana Zatarain stated tourism sales fell 25 to 35 percent over two years.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: She added that at least 27 restaurants have closed or paused operations.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The contrast is clear: new investment keeps arriving while daily water supply stays tight. FITURCA still projects 300,000 Canadian visitors for the year.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The POEL process now requires developers to present desal, wastewater, and waste plans before approval.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That rule tries to put the real costs of growth on the balance sheet from the start. It is one way to link tourism plans directly to infrastructure.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: FlightConnections data from September shows the airport here with 56 destinations.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That number concentrates pressure on one corner of the state compared with seven in La Paz. Air seats keep rising even as some hotels feel the pinch.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It is still too early to know how fast the closed taps will change measured flows.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Right. We see the enforcement step, yet the next round of supply data is still ahead. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The Los Cabos General Directorate of Public Security, Preventive Police and Municipal Transit lists its head for 2024 to 2027 as Cap. de Fragata C.G. Christopher Jordi López Monge.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That org chart sits inside a larger set of rules.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: On 20 October the Congress approved donation of three plots in Brisas del Valle, Ciudad Constitución, to INSUS.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Three plots? What sizes are we talking about?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The first one measures 27335 square metres.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: And the others?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: One is 17881 square metres and the last is 13576 square metres.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: All three for federal social housing with CONAVI.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Congress also approved one more plot of 15550 square metres in Los Frayles, Santa Rosalía, to INFONAVIT.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Same purpose, only social housing.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The EU Territorial Agenda 2030, issued by EU Ministers responsible for spatial planning in 2020, supplies the cohesion template for balanced development in places like Baja California Sur.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: How does that template reach the police directorate?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Through the land-use change pack that consults POERBCS with its 56 UGAs and the named policies of Sustainable Use, Preservation and Protection.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The urban deferrals listed in the planning guide include BCS40AS.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Yes, and also BCS41AS, BCS32AS, BCS31AS and BCS30AS.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: UN-Habitat’s 2019 synopsis on rural-urban linkages supplies global evidence on how those linkages support regional integration.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: ECLAC’s 2015 panorama calls for territorial pacts focused on equality.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The water_first scenario in the BCS 2050 database requires prioritising security on aquifers already in deficit.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Those aquifers carry the codes 0313, 0317, 0319, 0324 and 0318.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Desalination or demand management must come before any further growth is unlocked.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: None of those steps create new water availability.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So a single social-housing plot approval travels through the Congress decision, the INSUS transfer, the POERBCS policies and the water_first check.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Each step sits in a different document, yet all shape what the preventive police can actually secure on the ground.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The directorate therefore operates inside that chain rather than outside it.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: A land-use change request must still clear the same pack before any new housing or patrol area is added.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That is the hidden design.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: I keep wondering which office first stamps the water check before the plot reaches the police map. [pause]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal's Visión pillar under Governance reports that without instruments tying growth to measured ceilings, the current path wins by permit inertia.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: It notes governance accounts for two items this week, with EWMA at 3.57 and direction plus 0.50, leaning toward relief.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That number still points to modest progress on paper.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The aspiration is public decisions that make POEL, PDU, PMDU, consultations and ANP ceilings prior conditions rather than later paperwork.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Exactly, and the vision holds only if those instruments draw on the evidence the portal already holds.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Three levers stand out. First, close the marked gaps with evidence before larger public scenarios.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Which gaps exactly?

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Loreto and northern DMA, amenity rooms, Cabos PDU, and pumping MW.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Second lever?

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Keep public consultation and delivery of instruments to Congress visible levers, not closing paperwork.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: And the third?

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Use the state's constrained board reading as a permit criterion, not only as analysis text.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That last one could actually slow bad projects early.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The Tendencia 2050 describes Baja California Sur as a polycentric system rather than one coastal formula repeated north to south.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Los Cabos as tourism engine under water and power stress.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: East Cape stays in tension with protected areas.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Todos Santos and El Pescadero form the Pacific amenity spine.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: La Paz serves as the service capital and water-energy node.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Loreto anchors tourism and conservation, Comondú acts as agricultural hub with more room, and northern Mulegé remains a thinly documented corridor now holding a remote generation tender.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Four conditions shape whether that sum of roles stays intact.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Each vocation keeps its distinct role. New tourism or residential growth occurs only where water and energy show evidenced margin or non-DMA source.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: East Cape and Loreto respect ANP and POEL ceilings before scaling hospitality.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Comondú and the north add production or energy without emptying services or ANPs.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The watchlist flags water theft with a federal bill allowing up to ten years in prison and closures of illegal connections in Los Cabos.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It also tracks the second CSL desal plant at 75%, 250 l/s, due for completion in 2027. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: If those conditions hold, the polycentric path could still shape 2050.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Otherwise the inertia the portal describes simply continues.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Senator Susana Zatarain has put forward a proposal to treat water theft as a criminal offense with prison time.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Los Cabos has also reported uncovering illegal water connections this year, according to the headlines.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The BCS government is lending a plot in Comondú to the National Guard for decades and donating some health buildings.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? That places security forces into local infrastructure decisions in a new way.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It does shift the picture. [pause] Water theft moves from an administrative issue toward something enforced by courts.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: And the land loan gives the National Guard a longer-term presence in Comondú for operations.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal's aspiration is that tools like POEL, PDU and PMDU should shape these choices from the beginning.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That means using the evidence already collected rather than approving projects first and planning later.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: What stays unclear is how the new measures will be applied across municipalities and whether public consultations will guide them.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The takeaway is that public decisions now link security actions to earlier planning requirements. State and local authorities carry the main responsibility, yet questions remain on practical rollout.
